title: DAY 32/90
VISCOUS FLOW
scenes.voice: Day thirty two of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, seventy four days to go. Today, fluids get sticky: viscous flow and the boundary layer.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, fluid mechanics. Topic, viscous flow and boundary layer. GATE loves a quick laminar pipe flow numerical from here.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover Hagen Poiseuille flow in pipes, flow between parallel plates, the laminar friction factor, and boundary layer thicknesses: displacement and momentum.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. In laminar pipe flow, the Darcy friction factor is sixty four over Reynolds number, and peak velocity is twice the average. On a flat plate, laminar boundary layer thickness grows with root x.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Practice PDF is on Telegram now. Test from seven to nine P. M.: take it through the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 31 Toppers
scenes.voice: Momentum and flow measurement toppers! Rahul Yadav is rank one again, Sai Avinash takes rank two, and Kunal rank three. Well done, all three!
